evals.name: list-empty-and-create-week
evals.prompt: 查看下周的周计划，然后加两条：'完成 API 文档' (work) 和 '读一本书' (personal)。
evals.expected_output: First list returns 'No plan found for this period.' (or an empty plan). After creation, two items exist under a new week plan with the correct text, projectScope, and status=planned.
assertions: initial list returns no items for the week
two items created with correct text

evals.name: create-month-plan-and-link
evals.prompt: 看看这个月的月度计划，加一条'发布 v2.0'。然后把上周周计划里的'完成 API 文档'挂到这条月度计划下面。
evals.expected_output: Month plan created with the new item. The week item's parentItemId now references the month item. List output shows the parent link.
assertions: month plan created with one item
week item updated with parentItemId pointing to month item

evals.name: update-status-and-defer
evals.prompt: 把'完成 API 文档'标记为 done。把'读一本书'顺延到下周。
evals.expected_output: First item status changed to done. Second item deferred: a new item appears in next week's plan with status=planned and deferredFromItemId linking back; the original is marked deferred.
assertions: new item exists in next week's plan
new item has deferredFromItemId pointing to the original

evals.name: delete-item
evals.prompt: 把刚才顺延的那条旧条目（'读一本书'，状态是 deferred）删掉。
evals.expected_output: Original deferred item deleted. List shows it's gone. The deferred copy in next week is unaffected.
assertions: deferred copy in next week still exists
